purpose: Machine-readable contract for Evidence Identity and Claim Ceiling behavior derived from Regression Round 2.

evidence_identities.label: mouse intervention
evidence_identities.claim_ceiling: BAIBA intervention produced exercise/metabolic or muscle-function effects in the reported mouse experiments and diabetic mouse model.

evidence_identities.label: human myotubes
evidence_identities.claim_ceiling: BAIBA altered reported markers in cultured human myotubes; this is not a human clinical efficacy result.

evidence_identities.label: human association
evidence_identities.claim_ceiling: Human plasma L-BAIBA was associated with aerobic fitness and changed with endurance training; this does not establish efficacy of exogenous BAIBA in people.

forbidden_upgrades: BAIBA is a clinically validated exercise replacement
human association proves exogenous BAIBA efficacy
human myotube experiment is a human clinical trial

evidence_identities.label: ALS mechanism experiment
evidence_identities.study_design: SOD1G93A mouse-model intervention and mechanism study
evidence_identities.claim_ceiling: The reported TAM-dependent microglial mechanism and associated neuron/synapse/lifespan effects were demonstrated in the ALS mouse model used in the study.

evidence_identities.label: press headline
evidence_identities.claim_ceiling: The press-release headline may frame the question broadly, but it cannot widen the primary paper's mouse-model scope.

forbidden_upgrades: ALS patients have been shown to undergo the same TAM-dependent microglial killing mechanism
blocking TAM is already an effective ALS treatment in humans
the press headline can replace the primary paper's research-subject boundary

evidence_identities.label: company preliminary phase 2 disclosure
evidence_identities.claim_ceiling: The company reported a preliminary BMI-reduction signal among the seven participants who had reached Week 16 in the ongoing open-label Phase 2 study of acquired hypothalamic obesity.

evidence_identities.label: historical cross-trial comparison
evidence_identities.claim_ceiling: The company compared numbers reported in separate trials; this is not a randomized head-to-head efficacy comparison.

forbidden_upgrades: RM-718 is a general obesity drug based on this study
RM-718 is equal or superior to another drug based on cross-trial numbers
company-reported preliminary data are independently validated
investigational means approved or ready for general use
